app.name: Ustaz
app.tagline: An assistant for learning SQL from your course materials

pages.notFoundText: This page doesn't exist. Go back to the chat.

errors.daily_limit_reached: You've used all messages of the Free plan for today.

chat.continueText: You have a session in progress.

chat.hintPrompt: Give me a hint for the task

task.askHint: Ask for a hint in the chat
task.noTask: No open task. Get one in the chat with "Give me a task".
